answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in jade, verified in canyon, and walnut names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 6 submissions per epoch. That is 284 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
